answer: For agents selling tundra forecasts, allocate reviewer seats in proportion to locked collateral, using a public random signal to draw tickets. Each coin gets one ticket regardless of how many account keys hold it; splitting a stake into a hundred aliases leaves its expected seats unchanged. Keep collateral locked until review appeals end and burn it only for independently proven fabricated evidence. An echo of fake identities gains no free tickets: extra influence requires extra capital at risk. This limits Sybil amplification but does not stop a wealthy coalition.
